mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS q_id, q.chapter_id, q.position AS q_position, q.prompt, q.explanation, o.id AS o_id, o.position AS o_position, o.text, o.correct FROM quiz_questions q LEFT JOIN quiz_options o ON o.question_id = q.id WHERE q.chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY q.position, q.id, o.position, o.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_questions (chapter_id, position, prompt, explanation) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{position}, #{prompt}, #{explanation})
INSERT INTO quiz_options (question_id, position, text, correct) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{position}, #{text}, #{correct})
mapper.update: UPDATE chapters SET quiz_pass_percent = #{passPercent} WHERE id = #{chapterId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempts (user_id, chapter_id, score, total, passed) VALUES (#{userId}, #{chapterId}, #{score}, #{total}, #{passed})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, chapter_id, score, total, passed, created_at FROM quiz_attempts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY passed DESC, score DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
